title: Finite reduced blocks admit a positive residual-circle Schrödinger representation

representation.block: A finite set of Coulomb/Gauss-reduced real coordinates y and complex matter coordinates z_j carrying integer residual charges q_j
representation.measure: A centered finite-dimensional Gaussian measure whose covariance is block diagonal and scalar on every equal-charge subspace
representation.circle_action: (U(theta)Psi)(y,z)=Psi(y,exp(-i theta q)z) is a strongly continuous unitary U(1) representation
representation.dense_core: Polynomial cylinder functions are dense and invariant under the circle action and complex conjugation
representation.observables: Bounded residual-circle-invariant cylinder functions act as bounded multiplication operators
representation.boundary: The construction is blockwise and repository owned; it supplies neither a preferred continuum measure nor a quantization of the complete interacting observable algebra
